How it works

From checkout to work in two minutes.

No installation and no account with us — you duplicate the template into Notion or download the files.

  1. 01

    Choose kit, edition and language

    Pick a kit or the bundle, the Notion or the Word, Excel & PDF edition, and your language at checkout on Gumroad.

  2. 02

    Get access

    Right after payment you receive the Notion link or the download.

  3. 03

    Duplicate or open

    Notion: click “Duplicate” to copy the template into your own workspace — the free plan is enough. Download: unzip the file and open the guide first.

  4. 04

    Fill it in

    Follow the setup guide and the example entries to add your own information.

Boundaries

What the kits do — and what they don't.

What the kits do

  • Give you a clear structure for records, registers and policies
  • Show with example entries how each register is filled in
  • Explain the relevant EU rules in plain language
  • Help you document what you have done

What they don't do

  • Replace legal advice for your specific situation
  • Make your business compliant on their own
  • Submit notifications or reports to authorities for you
  • Classify AI systems or make legal decisions for you

Questions

Before you buy.

Do I need Notion?
No. Every kit is also available as Word, Excel and PDF files. For the Notion edition, the free Notion plan is enough.
Which languages are available?
Every kit is available in English, German, Dutch, Spanish and Croatian. You choose your edition at checkout.
How do I receive the kit?
Payment and your receipt are handled by Gumroad. Right after purchase you get either a link to duplicate the template into your Notion workspace or a ZIP file with Word, Excel and PDF files.
What is the difference between the two editions?
The content and the price are the same. The Notion edition is a connected workspace with views and automatic fields. The download edition gives you Word documents to edit, an Excel workbook with the registers and automatic deadlines and checks, and PDFs to print.
Can I use a kit for several companies?
One purchase covers use within one business. If you need kits for several companies or for your clients, please contact us.
Is this legal advice?
No. The kits are organisational tools and a practical starting point. They do not constitute legal advice and do not by themselves make your business compliant. For high-risk uses — for example AI in recruitment — have your final documents reviewed by a qualified professional.
Am I tracked when I click “Buy”?
Not by this website. It loads no Gumroad scripts and sets no cookies. The buy buttons are plain links; on the checkout page, Gumroad's own privacy policy applies.
